source: NGX (doclib.ngxgroup.com) | FILL 20261007: H1 2026 balance sheet added from the issuer interim. ZICHIS AGRO ALLIED INDUSTRIES PLC interim results for the six months ended 30 June 2026, statement of financial position: total assets 3,601,711,456; total liabilities 2,061,892,199; total equity 1,539,819,257; non-current assets 1,406,467,954; current assets 2,195,243,502; current liabilities 61,892,199; cash and bank balances 1,146,314,623. Amounts are NGN. Source: https://doclib.ngxgroup.com/Financial_NewsDocs/47590_ZICHIS_AGRO_ALLIED_INDUSTRIES_PLC-_QUARTER_2_-_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_FOR_2026_FINANCIAL_STATEMENTS_JULY_2026.pdf

rows.label: Non-current Assets
rows.source: Zichis Agro-Allied Industries Plc audited financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025, statement of financial position, printed page 34 (file _ngx_pdf/ZICHIS.pdf); NGN. Non-current assets 741,396,207 (2024: 704,529,529); total current assets 484,318,426 (152,746,365); total equity 1,171,654,602 (833,591,751); total current liabilities 54,060,031 (23,684,143). No non-current liability line is printed. For 2024 the sheet prints total assets 867,276,894 while its own components sum to 857,275,894; the figure already stored (857,275,894) is the component sum and the split here ties to it, so the printed total is the internal inconsistency.

source_note: | ADDED 2026-10-06: Cash & Equivalents 17,468,682 and 8,669,564 read from the audited statement of financial position, page 34 of the report (Cash/Bank Balances line). The report prints a prior-year TOTAL ASSETS of 867,276,894 which does not agree with its own prior-year components (non-current assets 704,529,529 plus total current assets 152,746,365 equals 857,275,894, and equity 833,591,751 plus current liabilities 23,684,143 also equals 857,275,894), so the stored 857,275,894 is kept and the printed 867,276,894 is treated as a typographical error in the report.
